lessons.trigger_condition: a watched-path candidate is correctly covered during its PR and immediate main merge, but a later unrelated PR compares from the older generation source and re-flags that already-verified watched-path change as stale
lessons.prevention_rule: after a verified watched-path candidate merges, materialize a new Tablet GPT sync generation anchored to the resulting main merge SHA before evaluating later PRs; later unrelated PRs must compare freshness from that verified post-merge checkpoint while any subsequent watched-path change still fails closed
validation_required: source_main_sha equals the exact verified post-merge main SHA
the covered merge is an ancestor of the current head
the new generation carries no model weights, raw grading calibration, or device-local runtime memory
a later PR with no watched-path changes reports fresh while a later watched-path change still reports TABLET_GPT_SYNC_STALE
lessons.safety_boundary: do not ignore watched changes, do not broaden exclusions, do not auto-promote device-local learning, and do not treat unverified physical Drive or tablet state as synchronized
